name: fhir-r4-react
description: React surface for the FHIR R4 slice — a BearerToken-driven `buildFhirR4ResourcesClientLayer()` + structural router-context (`sliceRuntimeLayer`, `useFhirR4ResourcesRuntimeLayer`) the host app merges into its composed `runtimeLayer`, plus the `Patient` TanStack-Query read. Cross-slice consumers: `gatekeeper-react`'s patient picker (`usePatientsQuery`) and `collector-react`'s `useSyncRunner` (imperative per-resource PUT via the runtime layer). Mirrors gatekeeper-react's migrated pattern; names are FhirR4-specific so future FHIR-version slices can coexist.
